checks.name: Every published table row carries a source
checks.rule: Each <td> that ends a row contains an https link to a registered source or an explicit blank marker.
checks.proves: No number reaches a page without the page it came from.
checks.does_not_prove: That the cited page still states the value; external availability is not checked here.

checks.name: Margin and total re-derive from the scores
checks.rule: home_score - away_score == margin_home and home_score + away_score == total for every inlined result.
checks.does_not_prove: That the scores themselves are right; the official reconciliation covers that.

checks.name: Week 9 finals reconcile to NFL.com
checks.rule: Each of the 15 official finals equals the feed's score, or is reported as absent.
checks.does_not_prove: Anything before Week 9 2026, which was not read against an official page this session.

checks.name: The stale snapshot is proven stale, not assumed
checks.rule: The official Week 10 Thursday result is checked for presence in the committed feed.
checks.proves: WAS at NYG is 24-21 officially and absent from the snapshot.
checks.does_not_prove: That no later refresh exists elsewhere; only that this feed lacks the game.

checks.name: Every price snapshot carries a provenance grade
checks.rule: Each snapshot has a quality field from the fixed grade list.
checks.proves: 7,103 snapshots graded; 0 are upgraded to verified without a timestamp.
checks.does_not_prove: That the unattributed price is the closing price.

checks.name: No snapshot is labelled opening or closing without a timestamp
checks.rule: verified_open + verified_close == 0 unless a source states a capture time.
checks.proves: The ordering claim is refused where the data cannot support it.
checks.does_not_prove: That no timestamped feed exists anywhere; only that none is held here.

checks.name: Origination respects the side -> total -> moneyline dependency
checks.rule: No total or moneyline row has status 'originated' unless its side row does.
checks.proves: The ordering is a code dependency, not a label on a page.

checks.name: Fair, market and difference are three separate columns
checks.rule: Each originated row has the three fields and difference is arithmetically fair minus market.
checks.proves: A reader can disagree with the model without losing the market's view.
checks.does_not_prove: That the fair line is calibrated.

checks.name: Signal and staking are computed from separate inputs
checks.rule: Signal uses beat-the-close (price-free); staking uses only priced bets.
checks.proves: Staking can never include a bet the signal column did not see.

checks.name: Ranking sorts on signal before staking
checks.rule: The leaderboard order is gates desc, then beat-close desc, then ROI desc.
checks.proves: A lucky staking run cannot lift a strategy with a weaker signal.
checks.does_not_prove: That the weights are optimal; ranking is lexicographic, not weighted.

checks.name: Every correlation publishes n and an interval
checks.rule: Each coefficient has n >= 3 and a two-element confidence interval.
checks.proves: A reader can judge precision rather than taking a bare r.
checks.does_not_prove: That the correlation is causal or stable per season.

checks.name: Correlations use no market input
checks.rule: The correlation builder reads only player-week box scores (plus team points for three pairs).
checks.does_not_prove: That box-score credits are perfect; they follow the official GSIS definitions but redistribution can err.

checks.name: Demotion is numeric and pre-committed
checks.rule: Every demotion rule has a stated trigger, action and rationale.
checks.proves: 6 triggers, each with an action and a reset condition.
checks.does_not_prove: That a demotion has ever fired; none has, because nothing is live.

checks.name: No strategy is LIVE without all ten gates
checks.rule: verdict == LIVE implies every gate id is true.
checks.proves: The verdict is derived from the gates, not asserted.
checks.does_not_prove: That the gates are correctly calibrated.

checks.name: Every suggestion is gated on a registered question
checks.rule: Each suggestion's blocked_by resolves to an id in the questions register.
checks.does_not_prove: That the questions are the right ones.

checks.name: The official injury transcription matches an independent one
checks.rule: Every shared (club, player) row agrees on game status with the repository's separate transcription.
checks.proves: 28 clubs; 0 status disagreements on 191 shared rows.
checks.does_not_prove: That either transcription is complete against the live page; the page can change after the read.

checks.name: No page claims an official depth rank
checks.rule: The only depth ranks published are measured from participation and labelled so.
checks.proves: The 404 is recorded as a source, so the gap is documented rather than implied.
checks.does_not_prove: That no official depth data exists anywhere; only that the league path 404s.

checks.name: Raw downloads are never committed
checks.rule: Only pruned extracts and derived JSON live in data/; raw multi-megabyte feeds stay out.
checks.proves: The repository stays reviewable and clones stay small.
checks.does_not_prove: That no large file exists elsewhere in the tree.
